The '''''Karthakk Queen''''' was a [[X4 Gunship/Legends|X4 Gunship]] that was used by the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was destroyed by [[Black Epsilon]] in the [[Karthakk system]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].
